snippet.title: SlashZero - Demo Announcement Story Trailer｜PS5 Games
snippet.description:
Time-Limited DEMO Out Now! Timehackers,it's time to step into a fractured timeline, mend it and find the truth behind the chaos!

Add to wishlist at: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10018159. Launching in Spring 2027. 

SlashZero is a side-scrolling action roguelike game featuring a roster of unique playable characters, fluid action, aerial combat and infinite build possibilities. This time, new character, new playstyle!

In SlashZero, you will traverse through shattered timelines, wield flashy combo abilities paired with unique enhancements to take down Hieros-I and unravel the hidden truth of this broken world.

#ps5 #ps5games #stateofplay #SlashZero #roguelike #action
